name: github
description: Everything Tovu's assistant needs to work against a GitHub repository through the workspace's own saved credentials, with no git, no gh CLI, and no token ever passing through the assistant: writing and updating files in one atomic commit, dispatching and following a GitHub Actions run, reading a failed run's logs, committing the site's rendered static export, and backing up the site itself (database, media, themes, plugins, settings) to a private repository. Encodes the rules that generic GitHub knowledge gets wrong here — a 204 dispatch means queued and never deployed, a workflow only fires on the branch its own trigger names, a repository secret is the human's step and never the assistant's, a 403 on an org-wide listing is a normal app-scoped-token boundary rather than a broken credential, and editing an existing file means diffing the MODIFIED files and not only the added and deleted ones.
author: Tovu
